title: Business Education Teaching Methods
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to series of activities geared towards helping students learn."
Teaching refers to series of activities geared towards helping students learn.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method whereby students play a passive role in the learning process."
The teacher-centred method is a method whereby students play a passive role in the learning process.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with students' potentials for growth and development than with their abilities."
The theory y teacher is concerned with students' potentials for growth and development than with their abilities.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method where attention is paid to the individual learner."
The individualised teaching method is a method where attention is paid to the individual learner.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined by Russon and Wanous as one which provides for learning activity through the evaluation of evidence collected in the process of solving problems."
Discovery method is defined by Russon and Wanous as one which provides for learning activity through the evaluation of evidence collected in the process of solving problems.

Shorthand is a subject that allows students to develop skills at their own pace; therefore any teaching method adopted must take into consideration, students' unique and differing characteristics.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the compulsory subjects offered by junior secondary school students in Nigeria."
Business Studies is one of the compulsory subjects offered by junior secondary school students in Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the "Heart" or otherwise the central part of the lesson."
The presentation stage is the "Heart" or otherwise the central part of the lesson.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a way to encourage what has been learnt in order to make it part of the individual and this is achieved through constant practice."
Reinforcement is a way to encourage what has been learnt in order to make it part of the individual and this is achieved through constant practice.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a method whereby students are opportune to participate actively in the teaching-learning process while the teacher plays a more passive role."
The learner-centred method is a method whereby students are opportune to participate actively in the teaching-learning process while the teacher plays a more passive role.
